rules.title: Municipal tax surcharge on rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may seek a rent surcharge only for municipal property tax increases above the acquisition-year (or 1988) assessment, in an amount set by the Rent Regulation Officer under an approved formula. It is paid in 12 equal monthly payments, lasts 12 months, requires reapplication, may be imposed only at lease commencement or renewal, and requires registered units.
rules.quoted_span: The rental increase permitted for taxes is determined by the Rent Regulation Officer pursuant to a formula approved by the Rent Control Board.
rules.key_value: Tax surcharge per Rent Control Board formula; 12-month duration; paid 1/12 monthly
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation under § 155-21
rules.coverage_text: Rent-controlled rental units in Hoboken for which landlord applies for tax surcharge; coverage scope defined elsewhere in chapter.
rules.ambiguity_note: Section numbering in the extracted text is garbled; chunk begins mid-section.

rules.title: Water and sewerage surcharge
rules.requirement: A landlord may seek a surcharge only for municipal water and sewer charge increases above 1996 levels, in an amount determined by the Rent Regulation Officer under an approved formula, paid in 12 equal monthly payments and not counted as rent for cost-of-living increases.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord may seek a water and sewerage surcharge from a tenant because of an increase in the municipal water and sewer charges in excess of those assessed for 1996.
rules.key_value: Increase above 1996 water/sewer charges, 12 equal monthly payments
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation under § 155-21
rules.coverage_text: Rent-controlled tenants in Hoboken; scope defined elsewhere in chapter.
rules.ambiguity_note: Text layout places this paragraph under heading § 155-8, but it concerns the § 155-6.1 water and sewerage surcharge.

rules.title: Capital improvement surcharge cap
rules.requirement: A landlord may not impose a capital improvement rent surcharge without Board approval. The surcharge is prorated over the improvement's useful life, and base rents may not rise more than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any twelve-month period.
rules.quoted_span: In making this determination, the Board shall consider the nature and the cost of the improvement and the effect that the proration of the surcharge shall have on the existing base rents, it being the intent of this chapter that the base rents shall under no circumstances be increased by an amount greater than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any one twelve-month period.
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation under § 155-21
rules.coverage_text: Rent-controlled units in Hoboken; scope defined elsewhere in chapter.

rules.title: Capital improvement cost allowance for code violation work
rules.requirement: When computing the cost of a capital improvement, only 60% of the cost is allowed if the work eliminates violations of housing code provisions enacted after January 1, 1985.
rules.quoted_span: For the purpose of computing the cost of a capital improvement under this section, only 60% of the cost shall be allowed if it is for the purpose of eliminating violations of housing code provisions, which provisions were enacted subsequent to January 1, 1985.
rules.coverage_text: Capital improvement surcharge applications for rent-controlled units.

rules.title: Hardship rental increase requires Board approval
rules.requirement: A landlord who cannot meet operating expenses or earn a fair return may apply for a hardship increase, but may not impose any increase under the Article without Board approval and prior notice to tenants at least 20 days before hearing.
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall impose upon any tenant an increase in rent under this Article without first obtaining approval with the Board.
rules.key_value: Board approval required; 20 days' notice before hearing
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation under § 155-21
rules.coverage_text: Rent-controlled units in Hoboken; scope defined elsewhere in chapter.

rules.title: Rent control: no rents above authorized levels
rules.requirement: No landlord may charge rents in excess of what was received on the chapter's effective date, or on January 11, 1973 if that excess is above the rent authorized by the chapter.
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall, after the effective date of this chapter, charge any rents in excess of what he was receiving from the effective date of this chapter;
rules.key_value: Rents frozen at base levels except as authorized by the chapter
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation; each unit and each demand/payment is a separate violation (§ 155-21)
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to Hoboken rent control; scope and exemptions defined elsewhere in the chapter.

rules.title: Certificate of compliance required for regular rent increase
rules.requirement: A landlord seeking a regular rent increase under § 155-5 must include in the notice a certification of substantial compliance with building, housing, fire and property maintenance codes. Without it the notice is invalid and the tenant may refuse to pay the increase.
rules.quoted_span: If a notice of rental increase should be served without a certificate of substantial compliance, then that notice shall be invalid.
rules.penalty: Fine up to $2,000 per violation under § 155-21
rules.ambiguity_note: Date is from the amendment note (Ord. No. R-449), not necessarily original enactment.
